title: greengrass-deployment
description: Generate a Greengrass deployment project, vending component-version and deployment CDK infrastructure

name.description: Name of the Greengrass deployment project to generate
name.x-prompt: What name would you like your Greengrass deployment to have? i.e: MyDeployment

directory.description: The directory to store the project in.
directory.x-prompt: Which directory do you want to create the project in?

subDirectory.description: The sub directory the project is placed in. By default this is the project name.
subDirectory.x-prompt: Which sub directory do you want to create the project in? (By default this is the project name)

target.description: What this deployment targets. thing-group creates a new AWS::IoT::ThingGroup; thing and existing-arn import an existing thing or thing/thing-group by ARN.
target.x-prompt: What would you like this deployment to target?

thingGroupName.description: Name of the AWS IoT thing group to create and deploy to. Required (and only used) when target=thing-group.

thingName.description: Name of an existing AWS IoT thing to deploy to (imported, not created). Required (and only used) when target=thing.

targetArn.description: ARN of an existing AWS IoT thing or thing group to deploy to (imported, not created). Required (and only used) when target=existing-arn.

parentTargetArn.description: ARN of the parent deployment, for a subdeployment onto a nested thing group.

tokenExchangeRoleArn.description: ARN of the core device(s) token exchange role to grant prefix-scoped s3:GetObject on the artifact bucket. When omitted, the guide documents the policy to attach by hand.

artifactBucket.description: "create" to create a new retained artifact bucket, or the name of an existing S3 bucket to import instead.

deploymentPolicy.description: The deployment's failure handling policy. default leaves the service default (ROLLBACK); no-rollback sets DO_NOTHING explicitly; rollback sets ROLLBACK explicitly.

nucleus.description: The Greengrass nucleus your fleet runs. Documentation only today - nucleus lite supports a narrower set of recipe keys and IPC operations than classic, so the guide surfaces a capability warning when lite is selected; it does not change the generated infrastructure.

infra.description: Infrastructure to provision for this deployment.
infra.x-prompt: Which infrastructure would you like to provision?

iac.description: The preferred IaC provider. By default this is inherited from your initial selection.
iac.x-prompt: Which provider would you like to manage your infrastructure? (default: Inherit)

preferInstallDependencies.description: Whether to prefer installing dependencies after the generator runs. Set to false to defer installing when batching multiple generators (an install still runs if needed so subsequent generators can compute the Nx project graph); install once at the end.
